advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Guard the render pipeline against a silent `git show` failure (e.g. render to a temp file with `set -o pipefail`, verify non-empty, then install) so an empty/partial config is not written to /etc/nginx/conf.d/rebar.conf.
evidence: The subsequent `nginx -t` (line 34) and the `grep -c proxy_read_timeout # expect 4` check (line 46) would catch an empty/partial render, so the risk is mitigated but the render step alone does not assert the producer ran.
advisory.finding: The new render pipeline `git -C /var/lib/rebar/mirror show origin/main:infra/nginx/rebar.conf.template | envsubst '${REVIEW_BOT_PORT}' > /etc/nginx/conf.d/rebar.conf` masks a `git show` failure: if the ref is missing or `fetch` did not advance origin/main, `git show` writes nothing to the pipe, `envsubst` still exits 0 on empty input, and the redirect truncates the live config to an empty/partial file. The operator gets no signal from this command itself.
scenarios: origin/main not yet advanced by the fetch, or the template path renamed, so `git show` errors and produces no stdout — the live config is overwritten with empty content.
advisory.suggested_fix: Render to a temp file first: `git -C /var/lib/rebar/mirror show origin/main:infra/nginx/rebar.conf.template > /tmp/rebar.conf.tmpl` (check rc/non-empty), then `envsubst '${REVIEW_BOT_PORT}' < /tmp/rebar.conf.tmpl > /etc/nginx/conf.d/rebar.conf`.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Keep the `grep -n REVIEW_BOT_PORT # expect no output` check paired with the positive `grep -c proxy_read_timeout # expect 4` check so an empty/unrendered file cannot pass verification silently.
evidence: infra/runbooks/nginx-edge-render.md:48 `grep -n REVIEW_BOT_PORT /etc/nginx/conf.d/rebar.conf        # expect no output; all `${REVIEW_BOT_PORT}` occurrences substitute`

The positive `grep -c proxy_read_timeout /etc/nginx/conf.d/rebar.conf # expect 4` check at line 46 sits directly above and would fail (count 0/3) on an empty/unrendered file, backstopping the absence-based check.
Template confirmed to contain only braced forms, so on a genuine render grep correctly yields no output: infra/nginx/rebar.conf.template lines 2,5,67,77.
advisory.finding: The added verification `grep -n REVIEW_BOT_PORT /etc/nginx/conf.d/rebar.conf # expect no output` uses absence-of-output as its pass verdict, which cannot on its own distinguish 'render succeeded and all ${REVIEW_BOT_PORT} substituted' from 'file empty / never rendered'. Both worlds produce no matching lines.
scenarios: The config file is empty or was never rendered: the REVIEW_BOT_PORT grep passes vacuously, but the proxy_read_timeout count check above catches it.
